gloss: instantly; in no time; at once

definitions.gloss: instantly; in no time; at once
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening very quickly or immediately, often with a sense of surprising speed.

examples.japanese: たちまち⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: It became popular in no time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たちまち⟦{暗|くら}く→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たちまち⟦{町中|まちじゅう}→町中：28383_machijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: The rumor spread throughout the town in no time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧たちまち⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: As soon as the new store opened, a line instantly formed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}す→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧にいた⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たちまち⟦いなく→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When it started to rain, the people in the park disappeared in no time.

notes:
WRITING:
Can be written as {忽|たちま}ち, though hiragana is more common.

USAGE:
たちまち emphasizes the surprising speed at which something happens. It often describes changes, spread of information, or completion of actions that occur faster than expected.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- たちまち〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to instantly become ~)
- たちまち⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧ (to spread in no time)
- たちまちのうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in the blink of an eye)

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly literary. Used in both spoken and written Japanese.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - immediately (neutral, most common)
- ⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧ - in the blink of an eye
- ⟦{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に→瞬く間に：21215_matatakumani⟧ - in an instant (literary)
- ⟦{即座|そくざ}→即座：11861_sokuza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - immediately (formal)
